caption: The sample sits after the monochromator, so only the selected wavelength reaches it; the blank is read first to set 100 %T. The detector current is amplified and displayed as absorbance or transmittance.

spec.title: Single-beam spectrophotometer
spec.aria: Light from a lamp passes through a monochromator, then through the sample cuvette, and the transmitted light falls on a photodetector whose amplified signal is displayed as absorbance and transmittance.
